description: Register a webhook URL to receive notifications when actual recorded spend (from record_usage) crosses a USD threshold within a rolling window. The alert monitors your org's spend. Fires at most once per period_days while spend stays over threshold. Returns the alert ID. Requires your service API key on the MCP connection (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer); org_id defaults to, and must match, that key's org.

org_id.description: Organisation to monitor. Defaults to, and must match, the org of the service key on the MCP connection

period_days.description: Rolling look-back window for the spend check, in days (default: 30)

threshold_usd.description: Spend level in USD that triggers the alert

url.description: Public https webhook URL to POST when the alert fires (no private, internal or loopback hosts; redirects are not followed)

name: register_budget_alert
